fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional summary of what this flow does.
fields.triggerDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Use this flow when the user wants to schedule a meeting or asks about appointment availability.
fields.triggerDescriptionHint: Natural-language hint the LLM router uses to decide whether a user message should activate this flow. Leave blank to disable auto-trigger.

ONCE.label: Once per conversation
ONCE.description: After this flow ends, the router will not re-trigger it in the same conversation.

ALWAYS.label: Always re-trigger
ALWAYS.description: Whenever the user message matches the trigger description, the flow restarts from its first step.

HEURISTIC.label: Heuristic
HEURISTIC.description: Prompt-only contract per node + first-edge advance with a lightweight on-topic heuristic. No extra LLM calls.

LLM_JUDGE.label: LLM as judge
LLM_JUDGE.description: Same prompt contract plus a second LLM call after each turn that decides whether the reply stayed on topic, captured a valid value, and is ready to advance. Off-topic replies are replaced by a redirect message. ~200 extra tokens per turn.

STRUCTURED_OUTPUT.label: Structured output (single call)
STRUCTURED_OUTPUT.description: One LLM call per turn — the model returns a JSON object that bundles the user-facing reply with the verdict fields. Same enforcement as LLM as judge, lower latency and cost. Falls back to heuristic when the model cannot follow the JSON contract.
